title: MCP tool discovery silently blocks for 10 minutes when server returns a mismatched response id

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a valid, actionable bug report providing wire captures, version details, expected vs actual behavior, and an identified issue where tool discovery hangs for 10 minutes when an MCP server returns a mismatched JSON-RPC response ID.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing the silent 10-minute timeout during MCP tool discovery requires updating asynchronous request/discovery timeout handling and error reporting within packages/core/src/tools/mcp-client.ts. This falls under Asynchronous Flow & Integration and MCP protocol timeout management across the MCP client lifecycle.

summary.problem: MCP tool discovery blocks silently for 10 minutes when an MCP server returns a response with a mismatched request ID or fails to respond to tools/list.
summary.root_cause: When querying tools/list during MCP discovery, mcp-client.ts uses the general MCP default server timeout (MCP_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MSEC = 10 minutes) instead of a shorter discovery-specific timeout, causing startup to freeze silently when responses are ignored or missing.
summary.context: JSON-RPC 2.0 requires ignoring responses with non-matching request IDs. However, waiting for the full 10-minute execution timeout during initial tool discovery results in a poor user experience without feedback or error messages.

steps: Define a dedicated shorter timeout for tool discovery/probing (e.g. 5-10 seconds) rather than relying on the general 10-minute tool execution timeout.
Update discoverTools and refreshTools in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-client.ts to enforce the discovery timeout when requesting tools/list.
Emit a diagnostic warning or log message when an MCP server fails to respond to tools/list within the discovery timeout window.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: MCP tool discovery times out quickly (within the discovery timeout window) when an MCP server returns a mismatched response ID or fails to respond, emitting a warning instead of blocking for 10 minutes.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/tools/mcp-client.test.ts that simulates an MCP server returning a mismatched response ID for tools/list.
Verify that discoverTools times out using the shorter discovery timeout instead of waiting 10 minutes.
Assert that an appropriate warning/diagnostic event is logged when the tools/list request times out.
